notes: Energy nodes must be finite and strictly increasing with the configured endpoints.
Saved boundary spectrum must equal the imposed POWER_LAW spectrum.
Sample and resolved counts must be integer-valued and match the rendered direction workload.
The saved unresolved fraction must reconstruct exactly from the sample counts.
Nominal T and J_local must be finite iff N_resolved is nonzero and NaN otherwise.
Require 0 <= T_lower <= T <= T_upper <= 1 wherever nominal T exists.
Isotropic T bounds must reconstruct independently from T_resolved and sampled/resolved counts.
Nominal J_local(E) must equal T(E)*J_boundary(E) at every node where the nominal estimate exists.
J_local_lower(E) must equal T_lower(E)*J_boundary(E) at every saved energy node.
J_local_upper(E) must equal T_upper(E)*J_boundary(E) at every saved energy node.
Density bounds must be finite nonnegative and ordered around any defined nominal value.
Density file must equal 4*pi*int J_local(E)/v(E)dE reconstructed from the saved spectrum.
Lower density must reconstruct from J_local_lower with the nominal integration gate unchanged.
Upper density must reconstruct from J_local_upper with the nominal integration gate unchanged.
Total-flux bounds must be finite nonnegative and ordered around any defined nominal value.
Total flux file must equal 4*pi*int J_local(E)dE reconstructed from the saved spectrum.
Lower total flux must reconstruct from J_local_lower with the nominal integration gate unchanged.
Upper total flux must reconstruct from J_local_upper with the nominal integration gate unchanged.
Every channel-flux interval must be finite nonnegative and ordered.
Each requested energy-channel flux must equal the same integral over the saved spectrum.
Each lower channel flux must reconstruct from T_lower using the same channel quadrature and tolerance.
Each upper channel flux must reconstruct from T_upper using the same channel quadrature and tolerance.
